from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CreditImpairmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's credit impairment loss for the reporting period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/Securities code")
    credit_impairment_loss: float | None = Field(description="Credit impairment loss amount. Negative indicates reversal/gain (e.g., -95251432.28)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period for this figure")
    change_reason: str | None = Field(description="Reason for change mentioned in the document, e.g., '计提减值准备冲回'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt showing the credit impairment loss line")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    credit_impairment_records: list[CreditImpairmentRecord]
